svg.title: Free-Stuff-Near-You — Minimal Local Tag logo, v5
svg.desc: The unlettered soft-green tag makes the identical right and bottom lobes clearest. A single exterior contour and two identically spaced openings carry the tag and local-point idea. Paired with the exact Free-Stuff-Near-You name in deep green. Original, unadopted concept with editable text and transparent surroundings.

text.font-family: Avenir Next, Trebuchet MS, Arial, sans-serif
